'''[[Prime Justice]] Doori-Doori''' was the [[Kip (species)|Kip]] magistrate who sentenced [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] to serve 45 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]], or 15 Kip years, at the [[Girigard Subsurface Correctional Facility]] for mining [[Ulikuo gemstone]]s.
